BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why won't my car start? ASSISTANT:

There could be a few different reasons why your car won't start. Check the battery, fuel, spark plugs, and starter to see if any of these need to be replaced. If none of these are the issue, have the car checked by a professional mechanic.
